summary: A mixed day dominated by legal proceedings and retail sector dynamics. Delhi High Court granted interim bail in the Malviya Nagar hotel fire case, while UPI MDR changes threaten to shift small retailers toward cash payments.

bullets.text: Delhi High Court grants Malviya Nagar hotel fire owner Lovkesh Bajaj 4 weeks interim bail on medical grounds.
Small retailers may shift to cash and bank transfers to avoid UPI MDR impact on transactions above Rs 2,000.
Rupee strengthens to 95.8150 against dollar for third consecutive day as Brent crude eases to $101.5 per barrel.
Starbucks plans to open global capability centre in Chennai with 800 new jobs.
Gujarat High Court grants Adani additional time to respond to journalist Ravi Nair's plea against custody in defamation case.
